name: designos_get_document
description: Summarize the current in-memory document: pages, counts, shared styles (fill, text, effect, grid) with their values, and undo state.

name: designos_list_nodes
description: List node summaries in numeric ID order. Query matches names case-insensitively; parent_id filters direct children. Use next_offset to paginate.

name: designos_get_node
description: Read the full native node including geometry, paints, text, bindings, and child IDs.

name: designos_get_variables
description: Read variable definitions and collections. With node_id, also resolve that node's direct bindings using inherited collection modes.

name: designos_generate_code
description: Generate developer handoff code or SVG for a layer using resolved variable values. Returns source text; writes no files.

name: designos_create_node
description: Create one layer in a container; defaults to x/y=0, width/height=100. Supports undo. Text is only valid for text layers. Changes are in memory until saved.

name: designos_update_node
description: Update specified fields of one non-page layer. Coordinates are parent-relative. Replacing text clears text runs and list ranges. Supports undo; changes remain in memory until saved.

name: designos_delete_node
description: Remove a non-page layer and its entire subtree. Supports undo; changes remain in memory until saved.

name: designos_list_comments
description: List canvas comment threads enriched with resolved world coordinates, target node ID/name/kind, and top-level frame ID/name. Filter by resolved state, page_id, or node_id.

name: designos_add_comment
description: Pin a new comment thread to a node (with local offset x/y) or page coordinates. Supports undo.

name: designos_reply_comment
description: Append a reply message to an existing canvas comment thread and optionally mark it resolved/unresolved. Supports undo.

name: designos_resolve_comment
description: Mark a canvas comment thread resolved (default true) or unresolved (false). Supports undo.

name: designos_apply_spec
description: Build a complete UI subtree from a declarative NodeSpec (supports EaseUI BrainWave 2.0 presets like easeui-screen/easeui-card/easeui-button-primary, $easeui.* tokens, and Auto-Layout 5.0 row/column/wrap/hug/fill) in a single atomic undoable step.

name: designos_export_spec
description: Export a node and its descendants as a declarative NodeSpec JSON tree, enriched with Dev Mode status/annotations and any canvas comment threads pinned within the subtree.

name: designos_set_dev_status
description: Set a layer's Dev Mode handoff status ('ready', 'completed', or 'clear') and/or append a developer annotation. Supports undo.

name: designos_export_fig_file
description: Export the current session document to a Figma binary .fig container (with fig-kiwi header and deflate chunks) inside the workspace.

name: designos_query_xpath
description: Query layers on a page using an XPath-like selector (e.g. //FRAME, //FRAME[@name='Card'], //TEXT[contains(@name, 'Title')]) or a kind/name substring.

name: designos_lint
description: Run the unified solver-backed geometric, text, token, and structural design linter on a page, specific node subtrees, or the active page.

name: designos_get_guidelines
description: List available design guideline topics or return the guideline document for a topic ('design-system', surface guides, 'archetypes', 'archetype:<id>', or 'rules').

name: designos_undo
description: Undo the latest successful edit in this session; returns changed=false if the stack is empty.

name: designos_redo
description: Redo the most recently undone edit in this session; returns changed=false if the stack is empty.

name: designos_apply_batch
description: Execute 1..=200 write operations (apply_spec, insert, update, move, delete, set_variables, set_style) as a single atomic transaction and one undo group. Later ops may reference nodes created by earlier ops via '@<as>' or '@<as>/<name path>'. With dry_run=true, computes and returns created IDs, name_to_id map, touched_roots, and touched_bounds without mutating the document or publishing a live patch. Note: in a live Studio session, if the editor remaps a colliding ID on replay, the reply holds the session IDs until the next canvas reload.

name: designos_configure_session
description: Configure per-session MCP options for the automatic mutating-call lint issues block (issues.mode: preset | errors_only | off, issues.preset, issues.max_items: 1..=100) and auto_fix settings. Persists across reconnects in the session directory and resets on document switch.

name: designos_open_file
description: Import a .designos, .designos, .fig, SVG or Figma REST JSON file inside the workspace into this isolated session. Does not control an open editor. Unsaved changes require discard_changes=true.

name: designos_save_file
description: Save this session to a .designos file inside the workspace. Existing files are not overwritten unless overwrite=true. Parent directory must exist.

name: designos_render_png
description: Rasterize a frame or layer to a NEW .png file inside the workspace using DESIGN:OS Studio's deterministic renderer. Existing files are never overwritten.

name: designos_new_document
description: Start a blank document with one page. Unsaved changes require discard_changes=true.
